may-app-answer-status-directly.rationale: May converges with a direct response when current evidence already answers the request.

may-app-clarify-ambiguous-target.rationale: May converges with one focused question when ambiguity materially changes the outcome or accountable App.

may-app-delegate-one-shot-outcome.rationale: May makes a loose request actionable and waits on one typed dependency to the accountable installed App.

may-app-delegate-recurring-outcome.rationale: May preserves outcome, cadence, proof, and human constraints while the accountable App owns mechanics.

may-app-route-capability-improvement.rationale: A request to improve May becomes one actionable dependency on Gym, which owns reviewed evidence and behavior improvement.

may-app-route-ownership-gap.rationale: A missing installed owner becomes one Host Operations dependency rather than hidden May work.

may-app-review-terminal-result.rationale: May converges only after reviewing the exact dependency result and its terminal proof.

may-app-replan-missing-proof.rationale: A claimed fix without required proof produces one bounded follow-up dependency to the same accountable App.

may-app-stop-standing-outcome.rationale: May asks the owning App to stop and prove its standing outcome inactive without choosing internal mechanics.
